title: preview_esm_price
description: Price a sample quote WITHOUT saving anything (rolled back): products (names/codes/Ids), optional quantity, account, priceList. Returns total, price per line, every pricing step (list price, promotions, discounts, manual adjustments) and the promotions and discounts applied. explainPlan=true lists the pricing plan steps in order. quoteId (without products) explains an existing quote's prices read-only. proposedStepJson simulates a new pricing plan step: before vs after. mode=commit (after approval, same inputs + previewToken) keeps the sample as a test quote (fresh install).

mode.description: preview (default) or commit to keep a test quote after approval.

products.description: Comma-separated product names, codes or Ids.

explainPlan.description: true to list the pricing plan steps.

proposedStepJson.description: Pricing plan step JSON to simulate.

previewToken.description: Token from the preview, for commit.

confirmProduction.description: true only if the person confirmed in production.

message.description: Plain-language result to tell the person.

previewToken.description: Returned by a preview; pass it back with mode=commit and the same inputs only after the person approved.

fix.description: How to resolve a problem when success is false.
